global: This orange-brown, glossy miso broth with visible noodles and toppings sits in a white ceramic bowl with red geometric pattern and blue "ARASAKI" text. On top are dark green nori, pinkish chashu pork with white marbling, and golden-brown menma, all set on a warm brown wooden table with grain patterns.
